name: Affix | 6pk CBD Patches | Awake
description: All-natural focus without the crash, AwakeFIX™ is specially formulated to help provide you the vitality needed to get in the zone throughout your day and keep your head in the game. Patch on to keep the energy flowing and the vibe alive with an Affix Hemp patch. Ideal for: Focus Mood Boost Active Days Affix Hemp patches use transdermal technology to deliver through the skin. Our Hemp patch formula is all-natural, safe, non-habit-forming and contains no trace of THC or cannabis. Affix Patches provide consistent delivery over a 24 hour period. You can remove whenever you like. By adding our Proprietary Mineral Oil Blend (Lemongrass, Tea Tree Oil) to our all-natural Hemp formula, this patch supports with daily focus and mood enhancement.
